qualification_limits: The repository remains alpha and the selected profile candidate with production_ready=false. This acceptance closes only milestone 1 at its reviewed-source gate; nine first-release and two deferred milestones remain.

Python callers, token holders and filesystem writers are trusted cooperating local operators. Tokens do not authorize tenant subsets, and the profile is not a sandbox against code modifying internal objects or raw store files.

Runtime admission covers CPython 3.10-3.13 on Linux, macOS and Windows; this Linux run does not qualify every runtime, filesystem, mount, hardware device, dependency combination or power-loss guarantee.

Known random embedding fallback is excluded; custom backend identity and preprocessing declarations remain operator assertions, not weight attestation or a startup remote-availability probe. Test doubles prove boundary behavior, not live retrieval quality or agent outcomes.

Read-only SQLite preflight honors WAL and may use transient shared-memory or coordination files. Invalid raw configuration is rejected before provider or durable-state initialization; existing-authority inspection is not an immutable-file access claim.

Existing receipt transaction and retry guarantees remain bounded to authoritative SQLite. No new all-component transaction, network-filesystem, multi-host, cancellation, starvation or throughput guarantee is established.

Rendered context counts remain estimates. Final model/tokenizer/template budget binding, crash/filesystem qualification, complete migration coverage, mixed HTTP/process concurrency, live-agent value/campaigns, durable replay and release support remain open.
History remains retained without erasure or compaction. Per-request limits do not bound cumulative history size or full-history validation cost.
